title: THE DEEP-STAIRCASE ORTHOGONALITY (SPARC 0.69 < HI 1.08 < MIGHTEE 1.87 x1e-10)

staircase.note: brief 0.69 = G03D bare ratio 0.692 a0_DE (register); in-file deep fit 0.643 x1e-10

MIGHTEE.circular: D at the deepest ring is a definitional function of a0_eff at fixed g_N -- flagged

a_f_dark.within_HI_note: READING TAUTOLOGY (comonotone in V_obs at fixed model family) -- stated, not evidence

candidate_law.dust_quiet_limit: 0.229 a0_DE, SUB-DE (a0_DE is not the dust-quiet deep floor)

verdicts.V1: V1 THE ORDERING COVARIATE (rho/p per candidate on the per-galaxy a0_eff-deep, z0 pair N=90; MIGHTEE groups circular-flagged). (a) f_dark: WITHIN the RAR-class sample it is a REAL per-galaxy secondary parameter -- within-SPARC rho(a0e, D(R_max)) = +0.432, p = 1.3e-02 (C1) -- but within-HI rho = 1.0 is the READING TAUTOLOGY (C2), and BETWEEN samples the steps are ANTI-ordered: HI D med 1.04 < SPARC 2.33 (0.44x) while the HI a0e step is 1.24x HIGHER (C3).  (b) f_gas: pooled rho -0.032 (p 7.7e-01), within-SPARC 0.203 ns, and the HI->MIGHTEE step would need f_gas UP while f_gas falls with mass (C4).  (c) mass: within flat (G199 C7), pooled anti (-0.03), and the OVERLAP CONTROL splits 1.08 vs 0.98 x1e-10 = 1.1x AT THE SAME MASS (C5).  (d) redshift: +2.2% vs 1.4x needed, zero lever on the z0 pair (C6).  NO single covariate of the four ORDERS the staircase; the strongest axis is f_dark WITHIN the RAR-class sample (rho +0.43, p 1.3e-02).  RESIDUAL SPREAD within the best-ordered sample (SPARC): MAD log10 a0e 0.188 dex -> residual after F 0.175 dex (7% cut, C7), the residual floor at the RAR benchmark scatter.
verdicts.V2: V2 THE DERIVED F (closed form, non-circular within-SPARC set, N=32):  a0_eff-deep = 0.352 x a0_DE x D^(1.19 +- 0.58) = 0.33 x1e-10 x D^1.19;  equivalently in the equilibration fraction x_eq = 1 - 1/D (dust-dominated share): a0_eff-deep = 0.352 a0_DE x (1 - x_eq)^(-1.19).  Constants: C0 = 0.352 a0_DE (log10 C -0.454), p = 1.19 (16-84% 0.62..1.78, galaxy bootstrap), rms 0.252 dex, residual MAD 0.175 dex.  PHYSICS: p = 1.19 > 0 -> dust-dominated systems read a HIGHER deep scale (the equilibration channel is real within the RAR class), BUT the dust-quiet limit is 0.35 a0_DE = SUB-DE, NOT the DE anchor.  HONEST CAVEAT: at HI's own f_dark the SPARC law predicts 0.34 x1e-10 vs the HI step 1.08 -- 3.1x SHORT (C8): the closed form is the IN-SAMPLE second parameter, not the cross-sample staircase law.
verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the deep staircase: an IN-SAMPLE hidden second parameter (f_dark, x_eq) EXPOSED, and a SAMPLE-SELECTION (M/L) LADDER between the samples; the number that discriminates:  (1) the MIGHTEE top step is a mass-to-light CONVENTION, registered closable at ~100% of the step value: G133's SPARC-class fixed-Upsilon_star=0.6 refit of the paper's own data lands a0 ~ 1.08e-10 = 1.005x the HI step's R-free median (C9) -- the 1.87 stair collapses onto the 1.08 stair exactly as G133's systematics budget (max honest closure 0.097 dex) declared;  (2) the surviving z0 residual HI 1.08 vs SPARC 0.87 x1e-10 = 1.2x is AT THE SAME MASS in the overlap window (C5), SAME z, comparable M/L class; it is NOT explained by f_dark across the samples (C3: HI higher a0e at LOWER boundary D), NOT by f_gas (C4), NOT by the G011 z-evolution (+2.2% vs 1.4x, C6): that 2-dimensional z0 split is the real open deep-limit structure;  (3) WITHIN it, f_dark is a genuine secondary parameter (C1: rho +0.43, p 1.3e-02; F cuts 7% of the in-sample spread, C7) while C8 shows the same F under-predicts the HI step at HI's own f_dark by 3.1x -- the single-power-law reading is internally inconsistent across samples.  THE NUMBER THAT DISCRIMINATES (hidden parameter vs selection artifact): the HI->MIGHTEE step ratio 1.743x at face value vs 1.005x after the registered M/L march -- the top stair is SELECTION (M/L) to within a few percent; the residual z0 1.2x split is NOT closable by any registered systematic (G133 max 1.25x) and is the candidate physical floor, whose within-sample driver is f_dark (V1/V2).  VERDICT: the deep-limit normalization is not one constant (G199), not a single covariate ladder (this lane), not a pure sample artifact: it is a two-layer object -- a registered M/L convention ladder (1.87 -> 1.08) for the top step plus a real per-galaxy secondary parameter (f_dark/x_eq, sub-DE dust-quiet floor C0 = 0.35 a0_DE) exposed by the z0 residual split.
